verses.text: Ixlajwi chi', ix el heb' israel t'a Elim chi', ix jawi heb' t'a tzinan lum yik Sin, t'a skal Elim yet' Sinaí. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' nanhal schab'il ujalxo yelta heb' t'a Egipto.
Ayik ayek' heb' ta', masanil heb' ix alub'tanhan t'a spatik winhaj Moisés yet' t'a spatik winhaj Aarón.

Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Komonok ix el t'a sk'ol Dios to ha t'a Egipto onh chamkani. Hata' tzonh em k'ojan t'a stz'ey lum chenal chib'ej, tzonh wa'i, masanto tzonh te b'ut'ji. Palta a exxo tik ix onh eyik'kot t'a takinh lu'um tik yik tzonh cham ko masanil yuj wejel, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha t'a satcha'anh ol wak'kot tas ol he wa''a. Junjun k'u ol b'at he molank'e tas ol he wa''a, yuj chi' ol wila'' tato ol he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il, mato ma'ay.
Haxo t'a swakil k'ual, tze molankank'e yik chab'ok k'ual, tze b'oankan yik jun k'u chi' yet' yik yukil k'ual, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi' t'a heb' chonhab': --Ha t'a jun yemk'ualil tik ol eyojtakejeli to yel a Jehová ix ex ik'anelta t'a Egipto.
Haxo t'a k'inhib'alil ol eyilan stzikikial, yujto ix yab'i tas ix eyutej he lolon t'a spatik. Palta a onh tik, ¿tok ay kelk'ochi, yuj chi' tzeyal ko pekal? xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalanpax winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha t'a yemk'ualil tik ol yak' nok' chib'ej Jehová he chi'a. Haxo t'a junjun k'inhib'alil, ol yak'an he wa'el hato syala' jantak tze wa''a, yujto ix yab'i tas tzeyalub'tanhej t'a spatik. Wach'chom t'a ko patik tzeyalub'tanhej eyalani, palta malaj kelk'och a onh tik. Wal yel ha t'a spatik Jehová tzeyalub'tanhej, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun rato chi' ix yal winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winhaj Aarón: --Al t'a heb' smasanil to snitzkot sb'a heb' t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto ix yab'i tas ix yalub'tanhej heb', xchi winh.
Ha wal yik wan slolon winhaj Aarón t'a heb' yetisraelal chi', ix yilanb'at heb' t'a tzinan lu'um, ix sch'oxank'e sb'a stzikikial Jehová t'a skal jun topanh asun.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

--Ix wab' wal tas ix yal heb' israel tik t'a in patik. Yuj chi' al t'a heb' to a tiknaik t'a k'ik'b'alil, ol wak' nok' schib'ej heb', haxo sk'inhib'i k'ik'an swak' tas swa heb', masanto sb'ut'ji wal sk'ol heb'. Icha chi' ol aj yojtakanel heb' to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in, xchi Jehová.
Ha t'a jun yemk'ualil chi', ix jawi nhilnaj nok' ub', ix majel b'aj ay scampamento heb' yuj nok'. Haxo t'a k'inhib'alil t'a junxo k'u, ix em yal ak'wal t'a spatiktak scampamento heb' chi'.
Ayik ix takji yal ak'wal chi', ay juntzanh tas te kotak ix kan t'a sat lu'um, icha k'e'en che'ew yilji.
Manh yojtakok juntzanh chi' heb'. Ayik ix yilanoch heb', ix yal-lan heb' t'ay junjun: ¿Tastaxlaj juntzanh tik? xchi heb'. Ix yalan winhaj Moisés: --Haton he wa'el syak' Jehová tik.
Haton jun cheknab'il ix yak' tik: Syal he molancha'anh t'a junjun k'u, icha jantak tz'och eyuj yuj jaywanh ex t'a yol he pat. Ik'ekk'e junjunok echlab' yik junjun anima, xchi winh.
Ichaton chi' ix yutej heb' anima chi'. Ay mach niwan ix molank'ei, ay pax mach kennhej.
Hato a yechlab'il ix ak'chaji, maj yak' sobre t'a heb' niwan ix molank'ei, hanheja' k'okb'il ix yab'pax t'a heb' kennhej ix molank'ei. Junjun mach ix smolk'e jantak swa t'a junjun k'u.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb': --Max yal-laj he molankan yik he k'ik'an, xchi winh.

Ay mach maj k'anab'ajanlaj tas ix yal winh, ix smolankan jab'okxo yik swa heb' k'ik'an yalani. Ha tas ix smolkan heb' chi', ix och ha'ayaxok, ix k'e sjab' t'a junxo k'u, yuj chi' ix kot yowal winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' maj k'anab'ajan chi'.
Junjun k'inhib'alil smolank'e heb' jantak swa t'a jun k'u chi', haxo yik sja yok k'u tz'ulaxb'ati.

Haxo t'a swakil k'ual, junjunto echlab' sobreal syik'k'e heb' yik swa junjun heb', syalelk'ochi to chab'chab' echlab' yik junjun heb'. Haxo heb' ayoch yajalil t'a skal heb' anima chi', ix b'at yal heb' t'a winhaj Moisés.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh: --Ha jun chi' a Jehová ix halani, yujto a k'ik'an sk'ual ik'oj ip. Ha jun ik'oj ip chi' sk'ual yik tz'ik'jicha'anh Jehová. Tze tz'anhkan tas stz'anhchaji yik tze wa k'ik'an, tze mayankan tas smaychaji, tze sik'ankan yik he k'ik'an chi', xchi winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajan heb' anima tas ix yal winhaj Moisés chi'. Ix sik'ankanb'at masanil tas swa heb' t'a junxo k'u. Maj ixtaxb'atok, maj ochpax ha'ayaxok.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi': --Waek he wa'el kan eyuj ewi, yujto sk'ual ik'oj ip tiknaik, tze k'anab'ajej eyik'ancha'anh Jehová. Ha t'a jun k'ual tik, malaj jab'ok tas tze wa chi' tz'ilchaj eyuj t'a spatiktak campamento tik.
Yujto anhej t'a wake' k'u t'a yol semana syal he molan tas tze wa''a, haxo t'a yukil k'ual, manhxalaj tas sjawi, yujto sk'ual ik'oj ip, xchi winh.
Palta ay heb' ix b'at sayan yik t'a yukil k'ual chi', palta malaj jab'ok tas ix ilchaj yuj heb'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Yelxo wal max he k'anab'ajej, ¿tom ol ex ochnhej ijan he tenanek' in cheknab'il yet' in k'ayb'ub'al?

Naek wal sik'lab'il, a in Jehová in swala' to yowalil tze k'anab'ajej sk'ual ik'oj ip. Yuj chi' ha t'a swakil k'ual, swak' wa'el t'a chab' k'ual, yuj chi' ha t'a jun k'ual chi', wach'nhej eyajek' t'a yol b'ajtak ayex, malaj mach sb'at munlajel, xchi t'a winh.
Ichaton chi' ix aji, ix yik'an yip heb' anima t'a yukil k'ual chi'.
Maná ix yak' heb' israel skuch juntzanh wa'el ix smol chi'. Saksak yilji icha wal sat anh culantro. Te chi' swaji, icha ixim k'oxox pan ayoch yalchab' t'ay.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Moisés: --Ix yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Sik'ekb'at junok echlab' maná, yik ol yil heb' eyuninal t'a b'ak'inh. Ol yil he wa'el heb' ix wak' he wa t'a lum tzinan lu'um tik, ayik ix ex wik'anelta t'a Egipto, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Yuj chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Aarón: --Ik'kot junok chen, tzak'anem junok echlab' maná t'a yo'ol icha yalan Jehová. Slajwi chi', tza sik'ankanb'at t'a yichanh Jehová chi', yik wach' ol yil heb' kinhtilal, xchi winh.
Icha ix yutej Jehová yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi', icha chi' ix yutej winhaj Aarón, ix sik'ankanb'at winh t'a stz'ey k'e'en k'e'en b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan strato Jehová.
T'a 40 ab'il ix swa maná heb' israel, masanto ix k'och heb' t'a lum kajnub'al t'a smojonal Canaán.
Ha jun echlab' chi', Gomer sb'i, ay am nanhalok yoxil litro ha ha' tz'em t'a yo'ol.
